utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club? I heard they’re picking the next read soon, and it’s supposed to be a good one.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh? Are they really picking it soon?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s what I heard — they’re narrowing it down this week, so we should know soon!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring it up with the group and repeat the plan so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — I probably would’ve missed that otherwise. Just let me know what the plan is.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll bring it up at book club and repeat the plan so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what’s the book club reading next?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard they’re picking a mystery novel this time—seems like everyone wanted something a little lighter.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Nice, that works for me. Do you know which mystery they picked?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m thinking of coming by the book club this week—what are you all reading?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re reading "The Lantern House" this week—if you want, I can save you a copy and a seat.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be lovely, thanks. I’ll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I just need to check the school pickup schedule first, then I can confirm for book club.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No rush at all — just let me know when you’ve checked, and we’ll save you a spot for book club.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — I’ll check the pickup schedule and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the book club — what’s the plan for the next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thank you, Eli — I’m still sorting out the details, but I’ll get you the plan soon. Maybe we can pick the book and time together?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me—let’s pick the book first, then set a time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Pia, I just heard the book club’s meeting is open next week — you should come! I’ll send you the details right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds nice, Quinn — could you send me the time and address? I need to make sure I can get there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the time and address right now so you can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m still hearing bits and pieces, but I’d love to know what the book club’s reading next.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re picking up `The Warmth of Other Suns` next, and I think it’ll give us plenty to talk about. I’ll send the details over once I’ve confirmed the date.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds great — I’ll keep an ear out for your update. Thanks for letting me know!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mara — before we plan anything for book club, what book are we discussing and when is the next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Hana! I don’t have the book or meeting time set yet, so we should pick those first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — let’s choose the book first, then we can set a meeting time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think I’ll come by, if that’s still alright. I’ve got a lot on my mind lately, but I’d like to hear what everyone’s reading.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely, come by whenever you can — we’d love to have you. No rush at all; we’ll save you a seat.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I appreciate that a lot — I’ll do my best to make it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — if the book club needs anything, I’ve got a few tools and I’m happy to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — that’s helpful. Do you have a couple of folding chairs we could borrow for tonight?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got a couple folding chairs you can borrow for tonight — I’ll bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m happy to help keep track—what time and where is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure yet—I still need to check the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No worries—just let me know when you find it, and I’ll keep it on my radar.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I can lend a hand with the book club if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I might take you up on that—I'm still figuring out the book club stuff.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No rush—just let me know when you’ve got it sorted, and I can help with chairs, snacks, or anything else.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to join, but I’ll need the exact time and address so I can plan the trip.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, fair enough — can you confirm the exact time and address for the book club?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t have that yet, so I can’t confirm it now. If you send me the time and address, I’ll make sure I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I’d love to hear what the book club is reading next—maybe I can help connect folks who’d enjoy it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be lovely—next up we’re reading "The Heaven & Earth Grocery Store." If you know anyone who might enjoy a friendly discussion, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll mention it to a few neighbors who’d love a warm, thoughtful discussion. Sounds like a great pick!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Book club starts tonight, right? I’ve got the snacks and a fresh stack of bookmarks ready.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep, I’ll probably drift in a little late, but I’m coming. Save me a bookmark and maybe one of those snacks?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Of course — I’ll save you both, and I’ll keep an eye on the good seat too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club picked a really lively read this month — should be a good one to chat about.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It should be fun — I just need to check it doesn’t clash with the school run. If it works out, I’d love to join in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, fingers crossed it fits around the school run — I’d love to see you there. If it clashes, we can always catch up on the next one.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — what’s the book club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re reading *The Thursday Murder Club* this month — it’s a fun one, and I think you’ll like it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, that sounds like my kind of book. I’ll try to make time for it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be happy to help—what’s up with the book club?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — can you help me pick a book for next month’s meeting?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — do you want something light and fun, or a bit more thought-provoking?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Nell, you should come to book club this week — I think you'd really like it. If you’re free, I’ll save you a seat.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks, Quinn — that’s really kind of you. I’m not sure yet, but if I can make it, I’d love to come.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Nell — just let me know, and I’ll keep a spot open for you. Would be lovely to have you there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet—where are we meeting for book club?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re meeting at the community room on Maple Street this Thursday at 7. I’ll bring the sign-in sheet and a few extra chairs if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — the community room on Maple Street this Thursday at 7. I’ll plan to be there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still meeting on Thursday, and should I bring the tea again?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, Thursday still works for me, and tea would be lovely if you don’t mind bringing it again.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll bring the tea on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, book club? I haven’t heard the latest yet—did they pick the next book?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I’m not sure—I forgot to check after the last meeting. I can ask around and let you know!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, that’d be great—I’d love to know what they picked.
